resetSubscriptionDescription: The link for this subscription stops working immediately, and the nodes already imported into your apps will all fail to connect within a few minutes.
resetSubscriptionSteps: In every app, delete the old subscription, then add the new link shown on this page. Refreshing the old subscription will not help.
resetSubscriptionTitle: After resetting, re-add your subscription in every app
resetSubscriptionUnaffected: Your plan, expiry date and used traffic are not affected.
